playbookCommonFailures: Company actually traded (bank movement, VAT201s filed) so a nil/dormant return would be false
Company not registered / activated for Income Tax on eFiling, or no public officer
Wrong tax year selected — several years outstanding and only one filed
OTP not relayed within the timeout

informationToProvide.label: Company Name
informationToProvide.aiHint: Registered company name (or individual's name if the taxpayer is a person) exactly as on the SARS profile, with the relevant SARS reference number.

informationToProvide.label: Company registration documents (e.g., CIPC CoR14.3)
informationToProvide.aiHint: CIPC CoR14.3 or registration certificate showing name, registration number and directors — used to match the SARS profile and to answer the company-structure questions.

informationToProvide.label: Confirmation that the company had no taxable income or business activity for the specific tax year
Relevant tax year details for which the return is required

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect eFiling access and nil confirmation
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Credentials on file, period identified and client has confirmed in writing that the return is nil
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Ask for the eFiling username/password and confirm which period the ITR14 is for. Get an explicit written confirmation in Communication History that the company had no income, no expenses and no assets/liabilities movement (dormant) for the financial year. Do not promise a turnaround shorter than 1–2 working days.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify period and that a nil return is appropriate
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Return is outstanding on eFiling for that period and nothing on file contradicts the nil declaration
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Confirm the ITR14 for that year is issued/outstanding under Returns → Returns History / Returns Issued. Check the CoR14.3 details match the SARS profile. If the company has a bank account, ask whether there was any movement. If evidence contradicts a nil return (e.g. VAT201 or EMP201 returns with values for the same year, or a bank statement with trading deposits), stop and raise a proposal to switch to the trading version of this service.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Submit the nil ITR14 on eFiling
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: ITR14 shows status Filed/Submitted for the period and the confirmation is saved
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Returns Issued → Income Tax (ITR14) → tax year. In the wizard answer "Is the company dormant?" = Yes (⚠ verify wizard wording) which collapses the financial sections; complete the company information and public officer details. Confirm the return shows zero taxable income and zero tax. A company that is inactive but holds assets is NOT dormant in SARS terms — raise a proposal if unsure. Stage with a screenshot of the completed return for Kevin's approval before Submit. eFiling login from a new device/IP triggers an OTP to the taxpayer's registered cell/email: pause, raise an otpRequest on the portal job via the OTP relay (Kevin, or the client through the Communication History link if allowed), 10-minute timeout then fail cleanly and reschedule. Never store OTPs. If a CAPTCHA appears, fall back to hand-off mode with the handoff sheet. Prefer filing from our practitioner profile if the taxpayer is already linked as a client; otherwise use the client's own login. If the taxpayer is not registered for the tax type on eFiling, stop and raise a proposal — do not activate tax types without Kevin.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver proof of submission
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Submission confirmation / filed return PDF posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Post the filed return / confirmation. Explain in plain English that a nil return still had to be filed and that the company must file every year while it is registered; mention deregistration if the client no longer needs the company.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the order can be completed
